title: COME TO JESUS, COME TO JESUS
author: Edward Payson Hammond
stanzas: Come to Jesus, Come to Jesus, Come to Jesus just now, just now. Come to Jesus, Come to Jesus just now!
He will save you, He will save you He will save you just now He will save you He will save you just now
He is able He is able He is able just now; He is able He is able just now
He is willing, He is willing, He is willing just now; He is willing, He is willing just now
Call upon Him, Call upon Him, Call upon Him Just now call upon Him Call upon Him Just now.
